about: Hand labels for 16 photos of 8 real products from Jonathan's pantry, taken 2026-11-15 on a Galaxy S24. Read by hand from the full-resolution originals before any model run. 'expected' is what a careful volunteer should do with this one photo: log it (date readable), turn it (no date in frame), or set it aside (chilled, or a stamp no one can read). Grader for keep-until dates: Food Banks Canada, Guidelines for Food Shelf Life (July 2018).
